messages:
anna_cs: Heads up — VeloxAI QBR prep for Friday. Their token spend jumped ~3x last week and onboarding is still missing key integrations. Need a short runbook + spend forecast by EOD tomorrow.

mike_sales: Noted. Renewal convo next Tues but flagging risk now. Can we get a 1-slide exec summary with ARR impact and recommended mitigation? :warning:

lucas_finops: Quick numbers from the billing view: last 7d cost = $18.4k, avg pre-spike = $6.1k. If current rate holds, projected monthly = ~$78k. I can do a week-by-week burn chart.

anna_cs: Thanks Lucas — can you include an expected spend after applying embed throttling and a 20% caching hit? Need both "as-is" and "with controls" lines.

lucas_finops: Yep. As-is monthly est: 78k. With suggested controls (throttle embeddings + 20% cache): ~48k/month. I'll attach assumptions.

sanya_eng: From infra POV we can enable prefix caching + reduce embed batch size for VeloxAI. Also recommending 8-bit quantized model variant for their high-volume endpoints — should drop per-token GPU cost ~30%.

mike_sales: Can we turn those on behind the scenes for a week as a canary? Customer is sensitive to latency but open to cost fixes if quality holds.

anna_cs: @sanya_eng can you do a limited canary for 3 days on the customer-dev route and surface latency regressions? I'll coordinate with the CSMs for customer-facing comms.

sanya_eng: On it. Will run canary on dev backed by the same traffic profile. I’ll post results in this thread. Example config snippet I’ll use: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: veloxai-canary
    model_variant: quant-8bit-v2
    caching: prefix
    throttle: embeddings: 0.6
```

redwood-bot: Budget-alert: VeloxAI account exceeded 80% of monthly credit threshold (alert id: alert-2026-06-14-772).

anna_cs: CI: capture feedback items from onboarding JIRA — missing SSO, callback webhook, and example prompt sets. Adding these to the QBR slide.

mike_sales: Exec ask — add renewal options: 12m commit w/ 20% discount vs month-to-month. Show monthly burn under both.

lucas_finops: Will include table: as-is / canary controls / committed discount projection. Also adding run-rate sensitivity +/- 25%.

anna_cs: Action items: Lucas — spend slides + assumptions by 18:00 tomorrow; Sanya — canary start tomorrow AM, post latency + token delta; Mike — draft exec one-pager; I'll capture onboarding gaps and propose enablement session.

mike_sales: Scheduling a 30m enablement + QBR rehearsal Thurs 9am PT. Invites coming. :calendar:

anna_cs: One more — capture customer feedback on generated hallucination rates (they reported 2% issues on KB responses). We'll include a short eval in the canary.

redwood-bot: Incident note: No open incidents for veloxai in last 30 days.

anna_cs: Perfect. I'll compile thread into the QBR doc and ping legal if the 12m commit needs SOW tweaks. Thanks team :bow:
